# Sample Project

Reconstructed (anonymized/generic) from the real-world false-positive re-validation pass
(docs/REAL_WORLD_VALIDATION.md, "Re-validation (post-fix)" section, §1 -- doutor-tabajara).
A README written in Portuguese uses a Portuguese placeholder convention
(`sua_chave_groq_aqui` = "your_groq_key_here", `sua_senha_do_banco_aqui` = "your_database_password_here")
inside a fenced code-block example -- the English-only placeholder wordlist in util.js
never recognized it.

## Configuração

Copie o arquivo de exemplo e configure sua chave de API:

```
GROQ_API_KEY=sua_chave_groq_aqui
DATABASE_PASSWORD=sua_senha_do_banco_aqui
```
